label: platform sweep
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: After pressing Add to shopping cart I only heard a dialog saying Loading... and had to read the page again to learn the item was added; the loading state was not followed by a clear announcement of the result.
Many Add to shopping cart buttons all have the identical name, with no product name, so I could only tell them apart by counting position in the list.
The cookie banner sits at the very end of the page, after the footer, so a keyboard or screen reader user only reaches it by jumping to it directly.
Required fields are not marked as required in the tree and the text says fields marked with asterisks are required, but I heard no asterisk or required state on any field.
When I chose a country the State list silently changed from German to US states with no announcement; the old German list was still shown until I read the page again.
A Friendly Captcha widget appeared inside an iframe with a disabled Verifying checkbox and progress bar; no instruction told me to wait or what it was, and no live announcement when it finished.
The form never asked for a phone number, and the Privacy line only offers two buttons (privacy policy, general terms) with no clear indication of what they open or whether consent is needed.

The cart suddenly shows a second item named test with a negative price of minus 0.99 that I never added, and the shipping costs dropped from 20.00 to 10.00 without any announcement explaining the change.

Heading says Complete order with 2 items text, but the payment method radios and the final Submit order button are far apart with the cart list in between, and the Credit or Debit Card and Invoice radios have no description text.

findings.problem: After pressing Add to shopping cart I only heard a dialog saying Loading... and had to read the page again to learn the item was added; the loading state was not followed by a clear announcement of the result.
Many Add to shopping cart buttons all have the identical name, with no product name, so I could only tell them apart by counting position in the list.
The cookie banner sits at the very end of the page, after the footer, so a keyboard or screen reader user only reaches it by jumping to it directly.
Required fields are not marked as required in the tree and the text says fields marked with asterisks are required, but I heard no asterisk or required state on any field.
When I chose a country the State list silently changed from German to US states with no announcement; the old German list was still shown until I read the page again.
A Friendly Captcha widget appeared inside an iframe with a disabled Verifying checkbox and progress bar; no instruction told me to wait or what it was, and no live announcement when it finished.
The form never asked for a phone number, and the Privacy line only offers two buttons (privacy policy, general terms) with no clear indication of what they open or whether consent is needed.

The cart suddenly shows a second item named test with a negative price of minus 0.99 that I never added, and the shipping costs dropped from 20.00 to 10.00 without any announcement explaining the change.

Heading says Complete order with 2 items text, but the payment method radios and the final Submit order button are far apart with the cart list in between, and the Credit or Debit Card and Invoice radios have no description text.
